note: Batch 3 Hard 正式候选 E-0056~E-0085（对应矩阵 §7.2 Hard 行 10 场景配额）与备选池 D-0020~D-0031。全部 gold_sql 只读、含真实业务子查询/多表 JOIN/比例/时间/多维组合，针对 db/ecommerce.db（seed=20260914）固定日期口径设计。销售/金额类排除 cancelled 并使用与题目语义一致的字段（订单级金额 orders.total_amount；明细件数/销量/明细金额 order_items.quantity/subtotal）。

candidates.question: 累计消费金额超过全平台用户平均累计消费3倍的用户有哪些？（请给出用户名与累计非取消实付金额）
candidates.gold_sql: WITH user_spent AS (SELECT o.user_id AS uid, SUM(o.total_amount) AS spent FROM orders o WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.user_id) SELECT u.username, ROUND(us.spent, 2) AS total_spent FROM user_spent us JOIN users u ON u.id = us.uid GROUP BY u.id, u.username, us.spent HAVING us.spent > 3 * (SELECT AVG(spent) FROM user_spent) ORDER BY total_spent DESC, u.id
candidates.notes: CTE 用户累计消费（排除 cancelled）+JOIN 用户表+HAVING 与用户均值3倍比较（comparison_to_average+标量子查询）。

candidates.question: 按用户累计下单次数将用户分为三档（1-3单、4-10单、11单及以上），各档分别有多少用户？
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN cnt <= 3 THEN '1-3单' WHEN cnt <= 10 THEN '4-10单' ELSE '11单及以上' END AS tier, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM (SELECT o.user_id AS uid, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o GROUP BY o.user_id) AS u GROUP BY tier ORDER BY tier
candidates.notes: 内层 GROUP BY 派生表（subquery）+CASE WHEN 分层+外层聚合。订单数=结构统计（含取消）。

candidates.question: 在售商品平均售价高于全平台商品平均售价的商品分类有哪些？（请给出分类名称与平均售价，取前5名）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(p.price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.status = 'on_sale' GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING AVG(p.price) > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products) ORDER BY avg_price DESC, c.name LIMIT 5
candidates.notes: JOIN+GROUP BY+HAVING 与全平台均价标量子查询比较（comparison_to_average）。实际达标分类恰 5 个，LIMIT 5 与结果一致。

candidates.question: 非取消订单中销量最高的5款商品是哪些？（请给出商品名称与累计销量）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY sold DESC, p.id LIMIT 5
candidates.notes: 三表 JOIN(products×order_items×orders)=multiple_join，销量=SUM(quantity)，排除 cancelled，Top-5（第5名126与第6名125无并列）。

candidates.question: 每个分类中，售价高于该分类平均售价的商品至少有多少款？请列出此类分类（含高级款数≥2的分类）及其款数。
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS above_cnt FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.price > (SELECT AVG(p2.price) FROM products p2 WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id) GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY above_cnt DESC, c.name
candidates.notes: 相关子查询（分类内平均）作比较基准（comparison_to_average）+GROUP BY+HAVING。

candidates.question: 销售金额高于全部分类平均销售金额的叶子分类有哪些？（请给出分类名称与销售额）
candidates.gold_sql: WITH cat_sales AS (SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS sales FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.name) SELECT name, ROUND(sales, 2) AS revenue FROM cat_sales WHERE sales > (SELECT AVG(sales) FROM cat_sales) ORDER BY revenue DESC
candidates.notes: 四表 JOIN(分类×商品×明细×订单)=multiple_join；CTE 聚合后与分类销售额均值比较（comparison_to_average）；金额用明细口径 subtotal。

candidates.question: 2025年销售金额最高的5个商品分类是哪些？（请给出分类名称与销售额）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS revenue FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.name LIMIT 5
candidates.notes: 四表多表 JOIN+年度时间窗+分类维度 Top-5；明细金额 subtotal，排除 cancelled。

candidates.question: 哪些商品分类的平均售价低于全平台商品平均售价的一半？（请给出分类名称与平均售价）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(p.price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING AVG(p.price) < (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products) * 0.5 ORDER BY avg_price ASC, c.name
candidates.notes: HAVING 与平台均价一半比较，低价类识别。价格比较基准=全平台商品均价。

candidates.question: 2025年各订单状态的订单数及其占2025年总订单数的比例是多少？
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31'), 2) AS pct FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC
candidates.notes: 状态结构统计（含 cancelled）+比例（标量子查询分母，ratio）。

candidates.question: 2026年实付金额高于全平台非取消订单平均实付金额的订单有多少笔？
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND status != 'cancelled' AND total_amount > (SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled')
candidates.notes: 订单金额与整体均值比较（comparison_to_average）+时间窗+取消排除。

candidates.question: 2025年各季度、各订单状态的实付销售额分别是多少？（不含取消订单；请按季度与状态列出）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN substr(order_date, 6, 2) IN ('01','02','03') THEN 'Q1' WHEN substr(order_date, 6, 2) IN ('04','05','06') THEN 'Q2' WHEN substr(order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07','08','09') THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS quarter, status, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY quarter, status ORDER BY quarter, status
candidates.notes: 季度×状态双维分组（multi_dimension_grouping）+CASE WHEN 季度；SUM(total_amount) 排除 cancelled。

candidates.question: 最近90天（2026年6月14日至9月12日）各地区各类别的销售金额最高的8个组合是哪些？（请给出地区、分类与金额）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT o.region, c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-06-14' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC, o.region, c.name LIMIT 8
candidates.notes: 四表 JOIN+90天窗+地区×分类多维分组（multi_dimension_grouping）+Top-8；明细金额 subtotal。

candidates.question: 哪些收货地区的客单价（平均实付金额）高于全平台非取消订单客单价？（请给出地区名称与客单价）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_amount FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY region HAVING AVG(total_amount) > (SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled') ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, region
candidates.notes: 地区客单价与整体均值比较（comparison_to_average）+GROUP BY+HAVING+取消排除。

candidates.question: 2024年至2026年每年的非取消订单实付销售额是多少，并分别占三年总销售额的百分之几？
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', order_date) AS order_year, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue, ROUND(SUM(total_amount) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled'), 2) AS pct FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY order_year ORDER BY order_year
candidates.notes: date_group 年度分组+双指标：Sales SUM + 占比 ratio（标量子查询分母）。

candidates.question: 2026年实付销售额超过100万元的月份有哪些？（请给出月份与销售额）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY month HAVING SUM(total_amount) > 1000000 ORDER BY revenue DESC, month
candidates.notes: 月份分组+HAVING 金额阈值过滤，识别高销月；排除 cancelled。

candidates.question: 2025年各月、各订单状态的订单数量分别是多少？（请按月份与状态列出）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY month, status ORDER BY month, status
candidates.notes: 月份×状态双维分组（multi_dimension_grouping）+date_group；订单量结构统计（含取消）。

candidates.question: 2025年中订单量高于全年月均订单量的月份有哪些？（请给出月份与订单量）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY month HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31') ORDER BY order_count DESC, month
candidates.notes: 月度分组+HAVING 与月均（2025 全年 12 个月）标量子查询比较（comparison_to_average）。

candidates.question: 最近90天（2026年6月14日至9月12日）内，日均销售额最高的5个商品分类是哪些？（请给出分类名称与日均销售额）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_date), 2) AS daily_avg_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-06-14' AND o.order_date <= '2026-09-12' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY daily_avg_revenue DESC, c.name LIMIT 5
candidates.notes: 四表多表 JOIN+90天窗+日均销售额（SUM(subtotal)/COUNT(DISTINCT 日期)）Top-5；排除 cancelled。

candidates.question: 2025年第四季度中，销量最高的3个商品分类是哪些？（请给出分类名称与销量）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY sold DESC, c.name LIMIT 3
candidates.notes: 四表 JOIN+季度时间窗+分类维度销量 Top-3；销量=SUM(quantity)，排除 cancelled。

candidates.question: 2026年下半年的订单数量是上半年订单数量的几倍？（保留两位小数）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-07-01') * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date <= '2026-06-30'), 2) AS h2_to_h1_ratio
candidates.notes: 半年对比 ratio（两个带时间窗的标量子查询比值）；订单结构统计。

candidates.question: 订单数量最多的5个收货地区是哪几个？它们各占订单总量的百分之几？（请给出地区、订单数与占比）

candidates.question: 2025年各收货地区的非取消订单销售额中，高于各地区平均销售额的地区有哪些？（请给出地区名称与销售额）
candidates.gold_sql: WITH region_sales AS (SELECT o.region, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region) SELECT region, ROUND(sales, 2) AS revenue FROM region_sales WHERE sales > (SELECT AVG(sales) FROM region_sales) ORDER BY revenue DESC, region

candidates.question: 收货地区与用户注册地区不一致的订单占全部订单的百分之几？

candidates.question: 2025年中实付销售额高于该年月均销售额的月份有哪些？（请给出月份与销售额）
candidates.gold_sql: WITH monthly_rev AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue FROM monthly_rev WHERE revenue > (SELECT AVG(revenue) FROM monthly_rev) ORDER BY revenue DESC, month

candidates.question: 最近90天内（2026年6月14日至9月12日），销售金额最高的5款商品是哪些？（请给出商品名称与销售额）

candidates.question: 2025年第四季度中，家用电器类目销售金额占该季度全部商品销售金额的比例是多少？（百分比，保留两位小数）

candidates.question: 2025年与2026年（截至9月12日）非取消订单的平均实付金额（客单价）分别是多少？

candidates.question: 男装与女装两个分类的累计销售金额分别是多少？（请给出分类名称与销售金额）

backups.question: 2025年第一季度中，家用电器类目销售金额占该季度全部商品销售金额的比例是多少？
backups.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(oi3.subtotal) FROM order_items oi3 JOIN orders o3 ON o3.id = oi3.order_id WHERE o3.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o3.order_date <= '2025-03-31' AND o3.status != 'cancelled'), 2) AS pct FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-03-31' AND o.status != 'cancelled' AND c.name = '家用电器' GROUP BY c.id, c.name
backups.notes: 备选：与 E-0083 同构（换季度），模板重复。

backups.question: 非取消订单中销量最高的10个商品分类？（分类+销量）
backups.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY sold DESC, c.name LIMIT 10
backups.notes: 备选：与 E-0059 同构（商品→分类维度），变化不大。

backups.question: 2026年各订单状态的实付金额合计及其占当年非取消总额比例？
backups.gold_sql: SELECT status, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS amount, ROUND(SUM(total_amount) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND status != 'cancelled'), 2) AS pct FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY status ORDER BY amount DESC
backups.notes: 备选：与 E-0064 相近（金额占比 vs 数量占比），可作候选。

backups.question: 最近90天内订单量最高的5天？
backups.gold_sql: SELECT order_date, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-06-14' AND order_date <= '2026-09-12' GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_count DESC, order_date DESC LIMIT 5
backups.notes: 备选：与 E-0073 同构（窗长 30→90 天），模板重复。

backups.question: 各收货地区的非取消订单实付销售额，按销售额高低列出前15名？
backups.gold_sql: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC, region
backups.notes: 备选：与 Easy E-0042/E-0051 接近（地区维度销售额），Hard 价值弱。
